services.name: Day Sail
services.desc: Adults: $50 (Ages 11+)Children: $50 (Ages 3 - 10)Infants / Toddlers: FREE (Ages 0-2) Our most popular sail of the day. Watch the sun set over the Pacific from Waikiki’s longest-running catamaran, a boat that’s been making this same journey since 1977. Whether you’re with someone special, your family, or a group of friends, the sunset sail turns strangers into fast friends every single evening. BYOB welcome, or grab a cold drink from our onboard cash bar. Catamaran Kepoikai II departs from the beach for all of our sails, so be sure to bring footwear that you can easily slip on and off! For any guests with mobility issues, please let one of the crew members know ahead of time so they can help

services.name: Sunset Sail

Catamaran sailing is one of the best ways to sit back, relax, and just take in the beautiful scenery of Waikiki Beach and the ocean surrounding it. Let the ocean be your sanctuary away from it all and take a relaxing catamaran sail aboard the Kepoikai II Catamaran. services.desc: Early Morning Memorial & Celebration of Life Sails Duration 1 hour About Embrace the serene spirit of Hawai’i with our Early Morning Celebration private charter, a deeply respectful journey to honor and celebrate the lives of your loved ones who have passed. Weather Policy Our tours operate rain or shine.
Light rain and typical island weather are considered safe and part of the adventure.
Cancellations made at least 72 hours prior to sail time will receive a full refund.
Weather Policy Private charters operate rain or shine.
Hawaii’s changing weather is often part of the experience, and light rain or normal sea conditions are considered safe to sail.
If the captain and crew determine that conditions are unsafe, we will cancel the charter ahead of time and offer a full refund or rescheduling option.
